text:
deploy-bot: Starting rollout for release v2.14.0. Canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Runbook linked: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/backout/escape-2026.md. Change window 09:00–10:00 PT. Canary scheduled on prod-us-east-1. Pinging oncall list. :rocket:
Lee (oncall): Acked. I’m oncall for the window. Who owns DB migration and rollback steps if we need to back out?
Maria G: I own the migration. It’s additive and reversible; revert command is `rails db:rollback STEP=1` for the migration job. Also kept a feature-flag toggle `ff:migrations_enabled=false` to freeze new behaviour.
Samir: Canary metrics to watch: p95 latency > 800ms sustained for 3m OR error rate (5xx) > 1.5% over 2m => immediate rollback. Also watch queue latency and the kv cache miss rate.
Jon: Ensure previous image tag is available: `redwood/inference:2.13.7`. Backout plan A = pin svc-inference to old image: `kubectl set image deployment/svc-inference inference=redwood/inference:2.13.7 -n prod`. Plan B = `kubectl rollout undo deployment/svc-inference -n prod` if we need quick undo.
Lee (oncall): Who will execute the kubectl step? I can run it if Samir or Jon give go-ahead. Also confirm if we need a DB migration rollback — Maria please advise during rollback.
Samir: I’ll watch metrics during canary. If triggers fire I’ll call rollback and @Lee will execute. Also make sure autoscaler policies remain relaxed for rollback spike.
deploy-bot: Canary (10%) started at 09:02 PT. Nodes: canary-01, canary-02.
qa-bot: Alert @channel: small spike in 500s observed on canary nodes, error rate now 1.9% (1m).
Samir: seeing the same in dashboards (grafana:svc-inference/canary). p95 up to 920ms on canary-01. Trigger condition met. Requesting rollback.
Lee (oncall): Rolling back now. Executing: `kubectl set image deployment/svc-inference inference=redwood/inference:2.13.7 -n prod` then `kubectl rollout status deployment/svc-inference -n prod` — will paste output.
Jon: Also remove canary traffic from load balancer just to be safe: `gcloud compute backend-services update ... --no-enable-cdn` (infra team pls run if needed).
infra-bot: Received request to drain canary nodes. Starting drain: canary-01, canary-02.
Lee (oncall): Rollout status: deployment "svc-inference" successfully rolled out. Image now pinned to 2.13.7.
Maria G: No DB rollback required. Migrations left intact; feature flag left as-is. After rollback, please run cache cleanup: `scripts/cleanup/clear-kv-cache.sh prod` and validate idempotency.
qa-bot: Post-rollback metrics: error rate back to 0.4%, p95 down to 220ms.
Samir: Confirming: metrics normalized across regions. Marking incident handled. Will file a postmortem if we detect root cause > 1 hour.
Lee (oncall): Filing short incident note and linking runbook. Notifying release owner to hold off on re-deploy until root cause identified. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Rollback complete and documented in runbook at https://internal.redwood/runbooks/backout/escape-2026.md#actions-taken. If re-attempting, perform a staged preflight: local integration smoke, dry-run migration, and 1% canary for 10m.
Jon: After action items: bundle the failing canary logs: `scripts/collect-logs.sh svc-inference canary-01 canary-02 > /tmp/canary-logs.tar.gz` and attach to the ticket.
Maria G: I’ll vet the migration and run it on staging again.
Lee (oncall): Closing thread — thanks everyone. If anyone wants to add missing steps to the runbook, edit: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/backout/escape-2026.md.
